verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Calendar Sync copies events from source calendars onto destination calendars and keeps them updated, so bookers see your "true availability across multiple calendars" (reclaim-docs-13, reclaim-docs-18, reclaim-docs-50, reclaim-docs-8), and it works with Google and Outlook calendars (reclaim-docs-47, reclaim-docs-33). Apple/iCloud calendars are only covered indirectly, by syncing a shared iCloud calendar into a Google Calendar (reclaim-docs-48), and conflict protection comes from mirrored busy copies rather than direct checking of every connected calendar. Missing for 10: native Apple/iCloud calendar connection, explicit documentation that every connected calendar is checked for conflicts at booking time, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-calendar double-booking prevention.
